post: Traffic spikes can overwhelm an API. Apache APISIX lets you apply request rate limits before traffic reaches your upstream services. This illustrative flow uses a limit per client IP on one gateway instance, with excess requests explicitly configured to return HTTP 429. Configure rate limiting:

sources.claim: APISIX 3.19.0 limit-req: rate 1, burst 0, remote_addr, local, rejected_code 429. Illustrative diagram; not measured output.
